changeSet.author: nexus-jv3ue
changeSet.comment: RDR-191 Phase 4 (bead nexus-jv3ue, Hal ruling o8dil.47): create nexus.taxonomy_centroids, copy all rows from taxonomy_centroids_384/768/1024, build all indexes, drop the three sources — ONE transaction, copy-THEN-index. See file header for the full derivation and divergences from the chunks template.
changeSet.sql: DO $$ DECLARE collision_count bigint; BEGIN SELECT COUNT(*) INTO collision_count FROM ( SELECT tenant_id, collection, topic_id FROM nexus.taxonomy_centroids_384 INTERSECT SELECT tenant_id, collection, topic_id FROM nexus.taxonomy_centroids_768 UNION ALL SELECT tenant_id, collection, topic_id FROM nexus.taxonomy_centroids_384 INTERSECT SELECT tenant_id, collection, topic_id FROM nexus.taxonomy_centroids_1024 UNION ALL SELECT tenant_id, collection, topic_id FROM nexus.taxonomy_centroids_768 INTERSECT SELECT tenant_id, collection, topic_id FROM nexus.taxonomy_centroids_1024 ) collisions; IF collision_count > 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RDR-191 unify (taxonomy-007-1): % cross-shard (tenant_id, collection, topic_id) collision(s) found -- the unified PK cannot represent a topic_id present in more than one dim shard for the same collection. Resolve the collision (retire the stale-dim centroid or renumber the topic) before retrying this migration.', collision_count; END IF; END $$;

CREATE TABLE nexus.taxonomy_centroids ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, collection TEXT NOT NULL, topic_id BIGINT NOT NULL, embedding_384 vector(384), embedding_768 vector(768), embedding_1024 vector(1024), label TEXT, doc_count INTEGER, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT taxonomy_centroids_pk PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, collection, topic_id), CONSTRAINT taxonomy_centroids_exactly_one_embedding CHECK (num_nonnulls(embedding_384, embedding_768, embedding_1024) = 1) );
DROP TABLE nexus.taxonomy_centroids_384, nexus.taxonomy_centroids_768, nexus.taxonomy_centroids_1024 CASCADE;

rollback.sql: CREATE TABLE nexus.taxonomy_centroids_384 ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, collection TEXT NOT NULL, topic_id BIGINT NOT NULL, embedding vector(384) NOT NULL, label TEXT, doc_count INTEGER, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT taxonomy_centroids_384_pk PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, collection, topic_id) ); CREATE TABLE nexus.taxonomy_centroids_768 ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, collection TEXT NOT NULL, topic_id BIGINT NOT NULL, embedding vector(768) NOT NULL, label TEXT, doc_count INTEGER, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT taxonomy_centroids_768_pk PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, collection, topic_id) ); CREATE TABLE nexus.taxonomy_centroids_1024 ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, collection TEXT NOT NULL, topic_id BIGINT NOT NULL, embedding vector(1024) NOT NULL, label TEXT, doc_count INTEGER, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT taxonomy_centroids_1024_pk PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, collection, topic_id) );
ALTER TABLE nexus.taxonomy_centroids NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
